What happens when you commit to walking 10,000 steps every day for 30 days? Explore the potential benefits, challenges, and changes you may notice in your energy, fitness, and overall health—and find out whether this popular daily goal is worth it.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
